---
title: "Introduction"
order: 1
---

Callout boxes help draw attention to information that participants should notice. They can be used for practical tips, important messages, warnings, or additional context.

This module demonstrates the different callout styles available in Quarto and how to add them to your course pages. Each example includes the code you can copy and adapt.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this module, you will know how to:

- Add callout boxes to a content page.
- Choose a callout type that suits the message.
- Add headings and text inside a callout.
- Create a collapsible callout for supplementary information.

::: {.callout-note}
## About callouts

Callouts are optional. Use them when highlighting information improves the learning experience. Avoid adding too many to a page, as this can make it harder for readers to identify what is important.
:::

## In this module

- **Topic 1 – Callout boxes:** Examples of notes, tips, important messages, cautions, and warnings.
- **Topic 2 – Collapsible content:** How to place supplementary information in a section that readers can expand when needed.
